data.clinical_information: Neonatal intensive care, premature infant 30 weeks gestational age.

airway.text: An endotracheal tube is present, tip at T1-T2 level, slightly high but acceptable
airway.label: present

gastric_tube.text: Nasogastric tube with tip in the stomach
gastric_tube.label: present

other.text: An umbilical venous catheter is seen with tip at the diaphragm level
other.label: present

heart.text: Heart size is normal for age

data.other_findings: Bilateral diffuse granular opacities consistent with surfactant-deficient lung disease.
data.impression: 1. Surfactant-deficient lung disease (respiratory distress syndrome). 2. Lines and tubes in acceptable position.
